description: This file defines a SwiftUI view 'OnboardingWizardView' managing an onboarding flow for an OpenClaw app, including QR code scanning, manual setup, and connection status management. It also includes internal enums and helper views for different onboarding steps.

classes.name: OnboardingWizardView
classes.description: A SwiftUI view managing the entire onboarding process with multiple steps, QR code scanning, manual configuration, and connection state display.

methods.name: handleScannedLink
methods.description: Handles a scanned QR code or deep link, extracting connection parameters and updating the setup state.

methods.name: openQRScannerFromOnboarding
methods.description: Prepares and opens the QR scanner sheet for onboarding.

methods.name: advanceFromIntro
methods.description: Advances the onboarding flow from the introductory step to the welcome stage.

methods.name: navigateBack
methods.description: Navigates back to the previous onboarding step.

methods.name: connectDiscoveredGateway
methods.description: Attempts to connect to a discovered gateway.

methods.name: selectMode
methods.description: Selects a specific onboarding connection mode.

methods.name: applyModeDefaults
methods.description: Applies default settings based on the selected connection mode.

methods.name: detectQRCode
methods.description: Detects and extracts a QR code message from image data.

methods.name: connectManual
methods.description: Initiates a manual connection to a specified host and port.

methods.name: saveGatewayCredentials
methods.description: Saves gateway token and password securely.

methods.name: saveGatewayBootstrapToken
methods.description: Saves a bootstrap token for gateway setup.

methods.name: scheduleDiscoveryRestart
methods.description: Schedules a restart of the gateway discovery process.
